canonicalDefinition: Biblioraft/dosar tip binder cu trei inele rotunde pentru coli perforate; exclude bibliorafturile clasice cu mecanism cu levier, dosarele simple fara inele, mapele, sistemele cu 2 sau 4 inele, mecanismele vandute separat si organizatoarele speciale cu fermoar.

observations.evidenceNote: Manual multi-query review confirms eMAG search/category counts are broad and cannot be treated as canonical competition counts. 'biblioraft cu 3 inele' shows 547 products in Bibliorafturi, but visible results include a set of 10 standalone 3-ring metal mechanisms (component, excluded), a lever-arch binder (excluded), a zippered 3-ring organizer (special organizer, excluded by canonical definition), and an explicit 2-ring binder lower on the surface (excluded). Earlier 'dosar 3 inele' showed at least one complete 3-ring kraft binder-like result, so canonical competition cannot be asserted as zero. Final eMAG state is competition present, exact canonical listing count unresolved; 547/1312/1417 category counts MUST NOT be used as competitor counts.
